2	//! GeoPalette Pulse ― Core Public API
3	//!
4	//! This module defines the primary integration surface for all consumers of the
5	//! `geopalette_pulse_core` crate.  
6	//!
7	//! Key responsibilities:
8	//! 1. Definition of domain–level events that flow through the Observer bus
9	//!    (see [`DomainEvent`]).
10	//! 2. A thread-safe, async-ready event bus implementation exposed as a
11	//!    process-wide singleton (see [`EventBus`]).
12	//! 3. Strongly-typed subscription and dispatch helpers with back-pressure and
13	//!    error handling.
14	//!
15	//! The goal is to provide a minimal yet expressive API that higher-level layers
16	//! (UI, analytics, storage, etc.) can rely on without leaking implementation
17	//! details of the underlying runtime or transport channel.
18	
19	#![warn(missing_docs)]
20	#![allow(clippy::module_name_repetitions)]
21	
22	use std::time::SystemTime;
23	
24	use once_cell::sync::Lazy;
25	use parking_lot::RwLock;
26	use thiserror::Error;
27	use tokio::sync::broadcast;
28	
29	/// Default size of the broadcast ring buffer.
30	///
31	/// Chosen to balance memory footprint and the likelihood of overflow in
32	/// high-frequency scenarios such as real-time motion tracking.
33	const BUS_CAPACITY: usize = 256;
34	
35	/// Re-export commonly used API surface for ergonomic downstream use.
36	pub use broadcast::{Receiver as EventStream, Sender as EventSender};
37	
38	/// Central singleton responsible for dispatching and receiving [`DomainEvent`]
39	/// occurrences across the application lifecycle.
40	///
41	/// Internally backed by a Tokio `broadcast` channel which:
42	/// * Guarantees fan-out semantics (every subscriber receives a copy).
43	/// * Provides back-pressure via bounded ring buffer.
44	/// * Is `Send + Sync` and therefore safe for multi-threaded use.
45	///
46	/// Consumers are encouraged to either:
47	/// * Keep an `EventStream` (`tokio::sync::broadcast::Receiver`) alive and
48	///   iterate using `recv().await`, or
49	/// * Use [`EventBus::subscribe_with_buffer`] for bespoke buffering needs.
50	///
51	/// NOTE: Overflowed events (receiver lagging behind) are reported via
52	/// [`DomainEvent::EventDropped`] and an [`EventBusError::Lagged`] error.
53	#[derive(Debug)]
54	pub struct EventBus {
55	    inner: RwLock<EventSender<DomainEvent>>,
56	}
57	
58	impl EventBus {
59	    /// Global singleton accessor.
60	    ///
61	    /// The `EventBus` is lazily initialised on first access, ensuring cheap
62	    /// start-up for unit tests and command-line tooling.
63	    pub fn global() -> &'static Self {
64	        static INSTANCE: Lazy<EventBus> = Lazy::new(|| {
65	            let (tx, _) = broadcast::channel(BUS_CAPACITY);
66	            EventBus {
67	                inner: RwLock::new(tx),
68	            }
69	        });
70	
71	        &INSTANCE
72	    }
73	
74	    /// Emit a new [`DomainEvent`] to all subscribers.
75	    ///
76	    /// Errors:
77	    /// * [`EventBusError::NoSubscribers`] if there are no active receivers.
78	    /// * [`EventBusError::Send`] for low-level channel failures.
79	    pub fn dispatch<E>(&self, event: E) -> Result<(), EventBusError>
80	    where
81	        E: Into<DomainEvent>,
82	    {
83	        let event: DomainEvent = event.into();
84	        let guard = self.inner.read();
85	        match guard.send(event.clone()) {
86	            Ok(_) => Ok(()),
87	            Err(broadcast::error::SendError(_)) => Err(EventBusError::NoSubscribers),
88	        }
89	    }
90	
91	    /// Create a new [`EventStream`] with the default ring buffer.
92	    pub fn subscribe(&self) -> EventStream<DomainEvent> {
93	        let guard = self.inner.read();
94	        guard.subscribe()
95	    }
96	
97	    /// Create a subscriber with a custom buffer size.
98	    ///
99	    /// Internally spawns a new `broadcast::channel` bridged from the global bus,
100	    /// allowing each caller to define its own capacity without affecting the
101	    /// primary channel. This is especially useful for low-priority consumers
102	    /// (e.g. analytics) that can tolerate higher latency.
103	    pub fn subscribe_with_buffer(
104	        &self,
105	        capacity: usize,
106	    ) -> Result<EventStream<DomainEvent>, EventBusError> {
107	        if capacity == 0 {
108	            return Err(EventBusError::InvalidCapacity);
109	        }
110	
111	        let (tx, rx) = broadcast::channel::<DomainEvent>(capacity);
112	
113	        // Spawn a task that forwards all global events into the custom channel.
114	        let mut global_rx = self.subscribe();
115	        tokio::spawn(async move {
116	            while let Ok(evt) = global_rx.recv().await {
117	                // Ignore lagging errors on forwarding; the consumer‐specific
118	                // buffer decides what to keep.
119	                let _ = tx.send(evt);
120	            }
121	        });
122	
123	        Ok(rx)
124	    }
125	}
126	
127	/// Strongly typed set of domain events emitted by the core.
128	#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
129	#[non_exhaustive]
130	pub enum DomainEvent {
131	    /// A new location reading was captured.
132	    #[cfg(feature = "location_services")]
133	    LocationUpdated(LocationEvent),
134	
135	    /// A new generative palette has been created.
136	    PaletteGenerated(PaletteEvent),
137	
138	    /// A brush was bought via in-app purchase.
139	    #[cfg(feature = "in_app_purchases")]
140	    BrushPurchased(PurchaseEvent),
141	
142	    /// The user attempted to share a palette or image.
143	    #[cfg(feature = "social_sharing")]
144	    ShareCompleted(ShareEvent),
145	
146	    /// An event was dropped due to subscriber lag.
147	    ///
148	    /// Raised by the bus itself so observers may log or escalate.
149	    EventDropped(EventDropMeta),
150	}

153	#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
154	pub struct EventDropMeta {
155	    /// Exact point in time when the drop was detected.
156	    pub at: SystemTime,
157	    /// Number of events lost.
158	    pub count: u64,
159	}

178	    pub algorithm: PaletteAlgorithm,
179	    /// Optional thumbnail PNG bytes.
180	    pub preview_png: Option<Vec<u8>>,
181	    pub generated_at: SystemTime,
182	}
183

185	#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
186	pub enum PaletteAlgorithm {
187	    MotionVector,
188	    AmbientLight,
189	    WeatherInfluence,
190	    #[cfg(feature = "location_services")]
191	    GeoHash,
192	    Custom(String),
193	}
194	
195	/// Purchase information payload.
196	#[cfg(feature = "in_app_purchases")]
197	#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
198	pub struct PurchaseEvent {
199	    pub product_id: String,
200	    pub price_cents: u32,
201	    pub currency: String,
202	    pub purchased_at: SystemTime,
203	    /// Whether the purchase has been verified via App Store / Play Billing.
204	    pub verified: bool,
205	}
206	
207	/// Sharing flow status payload.
208	#[cfg(feature = "social_sharing")]
209	#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
210	pub struct ShareEvent {
211	    pub platform: SharePlatform,
212	    pub success: bool,
213	    pub attempted_at: SystemTime,
214	    /// Remote URL once uploaded (if any).
215	    pub permalink: Option<String>,
216	}
217	
218	/// Enum of supported third-party platforms.
219	#[cfg(feature = "social_sharing")]
220	#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
221	pub enum SharePlatform {
222	    Instagram,
223	    Twitter,
224	    TikTok,
225	    Files,
226	    Other(String),
227	}
228	
229	/// All possible error conditions surfaced by the [`EventBus`].
230	#[derive(Debug, Error)]
231	pub enum EventBusError {
232	    /// Attempted to send but nobody was listening.
233	    #[error("cannot dispatch event: no active subscribers")]
234	    NoSubscribers,
235	
236	    /// Provided buffer capacity was zero.
237	    #[error("subscription capacity must be > 0")]
238	    InvalidCapacity,
239	
240	    /// Receiver lagged behind; carries number of skipped events.
241	    #[error("receiver lagged and lost {0} event(s)")]
242	    Lagged(u64),
243	
244	    /// Generic send/receive error.
245	    #[error("event bus channel failure")]
246	    Send,
247	}
248	
249	impl From<broadcast::error::SendError<DomainEvent>> for EventBusError {
250	    fn from(_: broadcast::error::SendError<DomainEvent>) -> Self {
251	        EventBusError::Send
252	    }
253	}
254	
255	impl From<broadcast::error::RecvError> for EventBusError {
256	    fn from(err: broadcast::error::RecvError) -> Self {
257	        match err {
258	            broadcast::error::RecvError::Lagged(skipped) => EventBusError::Lagged(skipped),
259	            broadcast::error::RecvError::Closed => EventBusError::Send,
260	        }
261	    }
262	}
263	
264	/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
265	/* Helper utilities                                                            */
266	/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

268	/// Shorthand convenience to publish an event through the global bus.
269	///
270	/// Example:
271	/// ```no_run
272	/// use geopalette_pulse_core::api::{emit, PaletteEvent, PaletteAlgorithm};
273	/// use std::time::SystemTime;
274	///
275	/// # #[tokio::main(flavor = "current_thread")]
276	/// # async fn main() {
277	/// let evt = PaletteEvent {
278	///     colors: vec!["FF3366".into(), "40BFFF".into()],
279	///     algorithm: PaletteAlgorithm::MotionVector,
280	///     preview_png: None,
281	///     generated_at: SystemTime::now(),
282	/// };
283	///
284	/// emit(evt).expect("dispatch failed");
285	/// # }
286	/// ```
287	pub fn emit<E>(event: E) -> Result<(), EventBusError>
288	where
289	    E: Into<DomainEvent>,
290	{
291	    EventBus::global().dispatch(event)
292	}
293	
294	/// Subscribe to the global bus using default capacity.
295	///
296	/// Spawns no tasks and is the lightweight variant.
297	pub fn subscribe() -> EventStream<DomainEvent> {
298	    EventBus::global().subscribe()
299	}

2	//! geopalette_pulse_core – integration tests
3	//!
4	//! These tests exercise the public surface of the core crate in a manner that
5	//! is as close as possible to what the production iOS / Android front-ends

7	//! API that is expected to remain stable for app‐store builds.
8	//!
9	//! All tests are asynchronous and executed on Tokio’s multi-thread runtime in

11	//! implementation.

Key Patterns & How We Apply Them 70 71 ### 4.1 Singleton – `RuntimeContext` 72 73 ```rust 74 use once_cell::sync::Lazy; 75 use std::sync::Arc; 76 77 pub struct RuntimeContext { 78 pub bus: EventBus, 79 pub repositories: Repositories, 80 pub clock: Arc, 81 } 82 83 static CONTEXT: Lazy = Lazy::new(|| { 84 RuntimeContext { 85 bus: EventBus::new(), 86 repositories: Repositories::default(), 87 clock: Arc::new(SystemClock), 88 } 89 }); 90 91 impl RuntimeContext { 92 pub fn global() -> &'static Self { 93 &CONTEXT 94 } 95 } 96 ``` 97 98 A `no_std` fallback (for WASM demos) swaps `SystemClock` with a compile-time feature. 99 100 ### 4.2 Observer Pattern – `EventBus` 101 102 ```rust 103 use tokio::sync::{broadcast, broadcast::Sender}; 104 use crate::events::*; 105 106 #[derive(Clone)] 107 pub struct EventBus(Sender); 108 109 impl EventBus { 110 pub fn new() -> Self { 111 let (tx, _rx) = broadcast::channel(256); 112 Self(tx) 113 } 114 115 pub fn emit(&self, event: E) 116 where 117 E: Into, 118 { 119 if let Err(err) = self.0.send(event.into()) { 120 tracing::warn!(?err, "No observers for {}", err.0.name()); 121 } 122 } 123 124 pub fn subscribe(&self) -> broadcast::Receiver { 125 self.0.subscribe() 126 } 127 } 128 ``` 129 130 We prefer `tokio::broadcast` over `async-channel` because it supports *fan-out* without allocations when only one receiver exists. 131 132 ### 4.3 Factory Pattern – `PaletteGeneratorFactory` 133 134 ```rust 135 pub enum GeneratorKind { 136 Basic, 137 Premium { brush_id: BrushId }, 138 Experimental(&'static str), 139 } 140 141 pub struct PaletteGeneratorFactory; 142 143 impl PaletteGeneratorFactory { 144 pub fn spawn(kind: GeneratorKind) -> Box { 145 match kind { 146 GeneratorKind::Basic => Box::new(BasicGenerator::default()), 147 GeneratorKind::Premium { brush_id } => { 148 Box::new(PremiumGenerator::with_brush(brush_id)) 149 } 150 GeneratorKind::Experimental(key) => load_experimental(key), 151 } 152 } 153 } 154 ``` 155 156 ### 4.4 MVVM 157 158 * **Model** – Domain entities (`Palette`, `Brush`, `JourneySegment`). 159 * **ViewModel** – Observable state machines (`PaletteVM`, `PurchaseVM`) living in `tokio` tasks and exposing *unidirectional* FFI bindings. 160 * **View** – SwiftUI / Jetpack Compose layers (out of scope for this crate). 161 162 --- 163 164 ## 5. 40	## Quick-Start

42	```rust
43	use geopalette_pulse_core::{
44	    bus::ObserverBus,
45	    events::{DomainEvent, LocationUpdated},
46	    factory::Factory,
47	    services::{LocationService, PaletteService},
48	};
49	
50	fn main() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
51	    // ------------------------------------------------------------------------
52	    // 1. Spin up the global Observer Bus (Singleton)
53	    // ------------------------------------------------------------------------
54	    let bus = ObserverBus::global();
55	
56	    // ------------------------------------------------------------------------
57	    // 2. Register a subscriber for palette updates
58	    // ------------------------------------------------------------------------
59	    bus.subscribe(|evt| {
60	        if let DomainEvent::PaletteGenerated(p) = evt {
61	            println!("🎨 New palette: {:?}", p.colours());
62	        }
63	    })?;
64	
65	    // ------------------------------------------------------------------------
66	    // 3. Construct services via the Factory pattern
67	    // ------------------------------------------------------------------------
68	    let factory  = Factory::default();
69	    let locator  = factory.get::<dyn LocationService>()?;
70	    let palettes = factory.get::<dyn PaletteService>()?;
71	
72	    // ------------------------------------------------------------------------
73	    // 4. Kick-off real-time location streaming
74	    // ------------------------------------------------------------------------
75	    locator.start_stream()?;
76	
77	    // ------------------------------------------------------------------------
78	    // 5. Generate a palette for an arbitrary coordinate
79	    // ------------------------------------------------------------------------
80	    let sample = palettes.generate_at(51.5074, -0.1278)?;

89	## Crate Features
90	
91	| Feature Flag        | Default | Description                                   |
92	|---------------------|---------|-----------------------------------------------|
93	| `location_services` | ✅      | Stream GPS, heading & altitude data.          |
94	| `in_app_purchases`  | ✅      | Purchase filters & brushes.                   |
95	| `biometric_auth`    | ✅      | Secure private collections with biometrics.   |
96	| `crash_reporting`   | ✅      | Forward errors to back-end telemetry.         |
97	| `social_sharing`    | ✅      | Share palettes to social networks.            |
98	
99	Use `default-features = false` in `Cargo.toml` to opt-out.
100	
101	---
102	
103	## Domain Events
104	
105	`DomainEvent` is an open extensible enumeration that represents everything the
106	app cares about.  Adding a new event never breaks downstream code.
107	
108	```rust
109	/// Every meaningful mutation in the domain is captured as a `DomainEvent`.
110	#[non_exhaustive]
111	#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
112	pub enum DomainEvent {
113	    LocationUpdated(LocationUpdated),
114	    PaletteGenerated(PaletteGenerated),
115	    BrushPurchased(BrushPurchased),
116	    ShareCompleted(ShareCompleted),
117	    // … downstream crates may add their own variants via the `NewType` pattern.
118	}
119	
120	/// Raised when latitude, longitude, altitude or heading changes.
121	#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
122	pub struct LocationUpdated {
123	    pub latitude:  f64,
124	    pub longitude: f64,
125	    pub altitude:  Option<f32>,
126	    pub heading:   Option<f32>,
127	    pub speed:     Option<f32>,
128	    pub accuracy:  Option<f32>,
129	    pub ts_utc:    DateTime<Utc>,
130	}
131	
132	/// Fired after a new colour palette has been synthesised.
133	#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
134	pub struct PaletteGenerated {
135	    pub id:        Uuid,
136	    pub colours:   SmallVec<[Rgb<u8>; 8]>,
137	    pub ts_utc:    DateTime<Utc>,
138	}
139	
140	/// Emitted when the user completes an in-app purchase.
141	#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
142	pub struct BrushPurchased {
143	    pub sku:   &'static str,
144	    pub price: Decimal,
145	}
146	
147	/// Raised after a share sheet returned successfully.
148	#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
149	pub struct ShareCompleted {
150	    pub provider: SocialProvider,
151	    pub ref_id:   Uuid,
152	}
153	```
154	
155	### Extending Events Downstream
156	
157	Downstream crates cannot modify `DomainEvent` directly, but they can embed
158	custom payloads:
159	
160	```rust
161	pub struct WeatherFetched(pub WeatherReport);
162	
163	let evt = DomainEvent::Custom(Box::new(WeatherFetched(report)));
164	bus.emit(evt)?;
165	```
166	
167	---
168	
169	## Observer Bus
170	
171	`ObserverBus` is a thread-safe, lock-free dispatcher that delivers `DomainEvent`
172	instances to an arbitrary number of subscribers without imposing an order.
173	
174	```rust
175	use geopalette_pulse_core::bus::ObserverBus;
176	
177	let bus = ObserverBus::global();
178	
179	// One-line ergonomic subscription.
180	bus.subscribe(|evt| println!("{evt:?}"))?;
181	
182	// Manual unsubscription is supported.
183	let token = bus.subscribe(|_| {})?;
184	bus.unsubscribe(token);
185	```
186	
187	### Threading Model
188	
189	• Each subscriber receives a clone of the event value.  
190	• Dispatch occurs on the emitter’s thread.  
191	• Long-running consumers must off-load heavy work to a task pool.
192	
193	---
194	
195	## Services & Factories
196	
197	All public services are defined behind `dyn` traits to facilitate dependency
198	injection, mocking and testability.
199	
200	```rust
201	pub trait PaletteService: Send + Sync {
202	    /// Synchronously generates a palette at the supplied WGS-84 coordinate.
203	    fn generate_at(&self, lat: f64, lon: f64) -> Result<Palette, GeoError>;
204	}
205	
206	pub trait LocationService: Send + Sync {
207	    /// Starts streaming live location updates to the Observer Bus.
208	    fn start_stream(&self) -> Result<(), GeoError>;
209	
210	    /// Stops streaming and releases the GPS chipset.
211	    fn stop_stream(&self) -> Result<(), GeoError>;
212	}
213	```
214	
215	### Factory Pattern
216	
217	`Factory` performs run-time type resolution while remaining `no_std`
218	compatible by using `anymap` under the hood.
219	
220	```rust
221	// Obtain the default factory which registers production implementations.
222	let factory = Factory::default();
223	
224	// Retrieve a concrete service erased behind its trait object.
225	let palettes = factory.get::<dyn PaletteService>()?;
226	let locator  = factory.get::<dyn LocationService>()?;
227	```
228	
229	New services can be registered at startup:
230	
231	```rust
232	factory.register::<MyMockLocationService, dyn LocationService>(Arc::new(mock));
233	```
234	
235	---
236	
237	## View-Model Utilities (MVVM)
238	
239	Although the UI layer lives in the platform-specific repo, the core supplies
240	helpers for building reactive view-models in Rust.
241	
242	```rust
243	use geopalette_pulse_core::vm::{Property, Observable};
244	
245	#[derive(Default)]
246	pub struct PaletteVM {
247	    pub colours: Property<Vec<Rgb<u8>>>,
248	    pub error:   Property<Option<GeoError>>,
249	}
250	
251	impl PaletteVM {
252	    pub fn bind(bus: &ObserverBus) -> Self {
253	        let vm = Self::default();
254	        let colours = vm.colours.clone();
255	        let error   = vm.error.clone();
256	
257	        bus.subscribe(move |evt| match evt {
258	            DomainEvent::PaletteGenerated(p) => colours.set(p.colours.clone()),
259	            DomainEvent::Error(e)            => error.set(Some(e.clone())),
260	            _ => {}
261	        }).unwrap();
262	
263	        vm
264	    }
265	}
266	```
267	
268	These primitives are platform-agnostic and bridge nicely to Kotlin Flow,
269	Swift Combine or Flutter Streams via `ffi`.
270	
271	---
272	
273	## Error Handling
274	
275	`GeoError` uses the `thiserror` derive macro and supports a
276	structured hierarchy:
277	
278	```rust
279	#[derive(thiserror::Error, Debug, Clone)]
280	pub enum GeoError {
281	    #[error("location services unavailable")]
282	    LocationUnavailable,
283	    #[error("permission denied: {0}")]
284	    PermissionDenied(String),
285	    #[error("network error: {0}")]
286	    Network(#[from] reqwest::Error),
287	    #[error("crypto error: {0}")]
288	    Crypto(#[from] ring::error::Unspecified),
289	    #[error("unknown: {0}")]
290	    Other(String),
291	}
292	```
293	
294	Every public API returns `Result<T, GeoError>` (or `anyhow::Result` for `main`)
295	so consumers can use `?` to propagate failures.
